purpose: Short paired controls, not universal real-time or physical-camera qualification
source: Original tensile reference as static fake 60 Hz camera, native UHD or unresized 1080p crop
numerical_configuration: Affine, 16/16, B-spline, two fixed levels, median, existing iterations and tolerance; GPU reference preparation in all variants

variants.synchronous: No supervisor option: synchronous recording, every-field native-size preview

primary_throughput: Committed disk fields per second, separately from computed replies
latency: Worker arrival to disk/library admission; median, p95 and p99 from raw samples
performance_interpretation: Report both repeats/ranges. Call a throughput advantage reproduced only if both candidate committed rates exceed the maximum baseline rate plus 2/observation_seconds (field-count boundary allowance). Two repeats do not provide a statistical or thermal qualification. Never claim 60 FPS unless actually observed at the required boundary.
